name: gt
description: Locale detection and AI translation for AppKit apps and agents, powered by General Translation.
onSetupMessage: Create a General Translation API key and store it as the Databricks secret bound to apiKey: npx gt login, then npx gt api-key create --project-id <id> --name "Databricks app" --permission project:translations:generate | databricks secrets put-secret gt api-key. The plugin finds the project from the key.

required.description: General Translation API key. Bind a Databricks secret with READ permission.

key.description: Databricks secret key name (deployment binding only)

value.description: Resolved secret value, not the secret key name

must: Bind GT_API_KEY from the apiKey secret resource
Register generalTranslation with the app's supported locales
should: Use the locale-selector block for language switching
Pass translation context describing where the text appears
never: Hard-code the GT API key in source or app.yaml
Call translate when the source and target locales match
